notes: The prompt says outright to make a racing game and the answer settles it as kart racing with 3 laps, so Racing on route-circuit, a closed loop run a set number of times, rather than the genre's point-to-point default. Circuit Racing is the matching preset and is taken whole; trigger-finish was added because a lap-counted race still needs the terminal line where the round ends, which trigger-lap alone does not provide. The stated Puma branding is dressing rather than a layout feature, and it lands on the options already chosen: barrier-guardrail carries the trackside hoardings the prompt calls racing boards, with logos repeated on the track surface and infield. The brief never says how many karts start, so I sized the grid to the small stylized circuit rather than asking: a narrow starting front a few slots wide, with the 3-lap count noted here since no field holds it.
